title: Evaluation-normalized internal Hom for a cartesian system input
statement: On the site and ring tower of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], fix SystemScalarCoherence [lem-coef-semilinear-scalar-coherence] and SystemTensorCoherence [lem-coef-semilinear-tensor-coherence]. There is SystemCartesianHomEvaluation as defined in the attached Lean module. For every cartesian first input M and index n it supplies a natural isomorphism e_n RHom_B(M,-) ≅ RHom_{B_n}(M_n,e_n(-)), whose tensor with the identity on M_n carries system evaluation, transported by the inverse tensor-evaluation comparison, to the actual level evaluation. It asserts no transition formula and constructs no scalar or tensor data.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Proposition 4.17(a), printed pp. 25-26; projection and Yoneda argument in steps 8-9 of lem-coef-semilinear-system-existence.

proof.text: Apply the proved derived singleton extension in the strict-system category. Transport its adjunction through strictSystemSequenceEquivalence.mapDerivedCategory. The composite inverse equivalence followed by strict evaluation is sequence evaluation. Identify its structural ring map with the eqToHom in the actual evaluation by sectionwise identity, and apply exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism localization. This proves that the actual e_n has a left adjoint, without adding an existence assumption.
Apply the cartesian projection formula for the chosen left adjoint of e_n. Its map is exactly the inverse adjunction transpose of the evaluation tensor comparison inverse after η tensor identity.

Curry tensorEvaluation inverse in its first tensor variable, obtaining a square e_n⋅tensorRight(M_n)→tensorRight(M)⋅e_n. Its inverse mate along the evaluation adjunction is exactly the unit-defined projection from step 2, so it is invertible. Its mate along the two tensor-Hom adjunctions is the desired Hom comparison. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv identifies this mate with conjugation of the invertible projection along the two composite adjunctions, hence it too is invertible. Mathlib mateEquiv_counit gives the displayed evaluation square directly; both naturality and its exact normalization are retained on the full derived category. Apply this argument with the supplied scalar and tensor coherence fields for each M, hM and n. Assemble the natural isomorphisms and their proved counit equations into the existing SystemCartesianHomEvaluation structure; this keeps the current nonempty theorem and every structure field unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and Proposition 4.17(a). Lean reduction by M7, 2026-10-26: reuse the proved strict singleton extension; split only the geometric cartesian projection; prove the mate/conjugation and counit calculation in full. Repair after return: port the reduction to the restored SystemCartesianHomEvaluation interface on current sheaf-dag; preserve its public structure and systemCartesianHomEvaluation_nonempty signature.
